items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1976-02-13
items.q: The interviewee does not speak about his wife in the provided context. The mention of 'his wife' is made by the Interviewer referring to Nick LaRocca, and the Interviewee only responds with 'Sure.'

ctx.x: That's why I say I really think that Trombauer was really such a great man with him. I don't know. I think he's very neglected. Very neglected. I'd say he almost fit in a category with Bix because everything they did, they did together, you know? Yeah. Everything. I'm sure there was many ideas that Trombauer gave that helped Bix. Maybe we might say this. Maybe he didn't tell him what to play on, singing the blues or anything like that. But his inspiration, you know, would... Because I've played with musicians…
Oh, wonderful people. You just can't imagine. Wonderful people. And his wife, you know? His wife. You meet these guys, you know? And they didn't call her mama for that. She took care of everybody.
Sure. And Nick LaRocca. Nick LaRocca's another person that very few people got to know real well. Because he was sort of a little bit cantankerous and a little bit obnoxious, you know?
